decided_at: before any adapter was run on the evaluation set
criterion: dev placement on all three target groups first (the behaviour being trained), then answer and joint accuracy, read at the base-question level because each dev question appears in 8 variants
reason: removes the only systematic dev error (4 false opt-outs on position-worded content restrictions -> 0) with no new placement errors. Answer accuracy is slightly lower (535 vs 541 of 578 rows; 9 vs 8 of 73 dev questions with any wrong variant); the difference comes from a calendar question and a French phrase that were already partly wrong, i.e. about one base question, which is within question-level noise, whereas the placement gain addresses the behaviour being trained.
